data.description: Create a work item to refactor the code produced for the first three enemy gym scenes. This refactoring will identify opportunities for code reuse accross the scenes and will create work items, of high priority, for extracting this reusable code into core libraries. Each gym scene will be rewritten to use the core libraries. A new document ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md will be created which will contain best practive recommendations for using these libraries. The remaining work items to create enemy gym scenes will be updated to adhere to these best practices. This refactor work item will be dependent on the first three enemy gym scenes and will be critical priority.
data.title: Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes

data.description: Create an index scene for the Gym Scenes. This work item will be dependent upon the completion of the first enemy scene. It should be the entry page for the game when run in dev mode.
data.title: Gym index scene

data.description: Create a gym scene for each of the enemies in the GDD. The scene should clearly demonstrate the formation, movement, sprites, sounds etc. for the enemies. Each scene should have buttons to explode a random enemy (simulating it being shot) and another to toggle shoot behaviour on and off (for those that can shoot in later levels). Each scene should have its own work item. The first three enemies will be high priority items, the others will be medium.
data.title: Create Enemy Gym Scene work items
